key_findings: All four datasets DO contain usable segmentation ground truth (HAM10000 is the ISIC-2018 Task-3 segmentation variant, not classification-only).
No exact filename/ID overlap with frozen TRAIN/VAL808/ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT/ROUTER_HOLDOUT/TEST.
HAM10000 shares the ISIC namespace/archive lineage with frozen task 0 -> semantic-duplicate risk HIGH, CHECK_REQUIRED.
Stones_where_are_you is multi-class COCO-seg (10 categories) -> requires a frozen stone->foreground rule; Roboflow-augmented '.rf.' filenames create a duplicate-source risk.
Three datasets carry prior research-programme use (HAM10000, CVC-ClinicDB, BrEaST-Lesions_USG) -> not pristine prospective validation.
BrEaST-Lesions_USG and CVC-ClinicDB lack a local license file -> CHECK_REQUIRED.
No PRIMARY_EXTERNAL_ELIGIBLE dataset is yet confirmed; Stones_where_are_you is the Track-A candidate pending mapping/protocol freeze.
